newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly firm with IPE, fuel flat.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly firm with IPE, fuel flat.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly stronger on Wednesday, traders said.
Premium unleaded gasoline barges rose $2 to $218/$220 fob ARA after a sharp rally in NYMEX gasoline futures and views the arbitrage to the U.S. worked for large vessels.
Naphtha rose with the jump in crude and some signs of end-user demand for February, despite high freight rates.
Gas oil gained up to $3 a tonne despite premiums coming under pressure, thanks to a $4 a tonne gain on IPE futures.
High sulphur fuel oil failed to follow futures higher, with plentiful product stored in ARA and more seen arriving.
